decisions.reason: The inbound SMS API builds directly on the firm's messaging, API and hosted communication expertise, and with in-house R&D the firm can learn from usage and refine it cheaply, so it remains a natural part of its multichannel offer.
The email-to-SMS gateway combines two channels the firm already runs, email security and messaging, so it can interpret early results and keep improving it within its existing cloud platform.
The SMS-to-email gateway complements Product B and draws on the same related knowledge and infrastructure, so it is cheap to maintain and strengthens the integrated communication proposition.
